notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-x performs reverse DNS lookup: IP address → hostname. Reveals the canonical hostname associated with an IP, which may differ from the domain being investigated. Reveals: virtual host configurations, infrastructure owner, internal naming conventions.

=== CHAINING ===
Shodan/crt.sh reveals IP → dig -x IP → hostname may reveal other services or owner → additional nmap scan targets.

=== PTR RECORDS ===
PTR records are in the in-addr.arpa zone. Reverse lookup may reveal internal hostnames for IPs acquired during enumeration. Missing PTR = no reverse DNS configured (common for CDN IPs).
